data.one_liner: Flutter diagram canvas for rendering, selection, pan, zoom, and text layout.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DiagramCanvas widget to render flowcharts, topologies, and workflow editors with built-in selection, pan, zoom, and themes. Allows embedding arbitrary Flutter widgets inside shapes and supports JSON and SVG codecs through related packages.
use_when: You need to build a flowchart, network topology, or process workflow editor in Flutter.
You want to render interactive diagram documents with pan, zoom, and selection capabilities.
avoid_when: You are building standard form-based or list-based business apps that do not require spatial diagramming.
You want a fully-featured commercial editor out of the box without purchasing additional extensions.
strengths: Supports embedding regular Flutter widgets inside shape nodes.
Includes light and dark diagram themes out of the box.
Handles navigation, panning, zooming, and marquee/element selection.
weaknesses: Advanced drawing tools, toolbars, and property inspectors require commercial extensions.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47 or later. Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and place the DiagramCanvas inside a bounded layout.
